historical_pattern.summary: One discovered parser entry. AFL++ or libFuzzer when that binary exists; otherwise a mutational search labeled as mutational. Shrink and independent replay use the existing evidence ladder. A missing executable entry fails closed.

invariant: A parser must not crash on mutated stdin.
prerequisites: bind.entry or parse.py under the target, or a coverage-engine binary in bind.binary

oracle.success_means: a mutated input crashed the parser and was shrunk

severity_rationale: A crashing input is an availability defect. It is not a logic bug, and a missing sanitizer build is not a sanitizer result.
